summary: Youlife Group Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering to a single institutional investor of a US$3,000,000 senior 9% original issue discount convertible promissory note, priced at US$2,730,000 (a 9% OID), plus 262,009 Class A ADSs as an additional 2% OID and up to 65,502,184 conversion shares, including 3,300,000 pre-delivery treasury ADSs. The note is unindentured; no placement agent is involved. ADSs closed at US$0.2343 on November 2, 2026. This is a routine ordinary financing, not a special situation; watch conversion dilution and ADS overhang.
